name: Kambala mine
title: Kambala mine
subtitle: Level 2 · in progress
summary: A company mine in the DR Congo: an open pit, a jungle and a mining village around a junction. Rebels come out of the forest to attack.
briefing: You start at the junction. Pick a base: the workshop on the pit floor (mine, north-east), the logging camp (forest, west) or the company HQ (village, south-east).
Clear its defenders and step inside. It becomes your base and the clock starts.
Fetch crates and build upgrades at the marked spots: construction at the sawmill and the equipment yard, ammunition at the explosives magazine, medical at the clinic, armour at the security post.
The rebels always come out of the jungle on the west side.

goals.claim: Clear a base: pit-floor workshop (mine), logging camp (forest) or company HQ (village)
goals.fetch: Fetch a crate and build an upgrade at a marked spot in your base
